title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Strawberry Raspberry Cherry brings together three of the most popular red fruits in a sweet and tangy blend. Juicy Strawberry leads with a burst of summer flavour, followed by the sharper edge of Raspberry and the deep, slightly tart richness of Cherry. The result is a bright, fruity vape with a bold berry kick. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, designed exclusively for the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Together, they offer up to 6000 puffs (depending on usage) of full-flavoured vapour and consistent performance. Powered by dual mesh coil technology, the pod ensures strong flavour clarity and smooth vapour delivery. An automatic refill mechanism and leak-resistant pod design make the system easy to use and maintain. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod provides a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and fast-absorbing nicotine for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Once empty, replace the pod and refill container to continue enjoying this flavour-packed fruit medley.
